sequence.body:
Hi John,

Hope you’re having a great week! Huge congratulations on stepping into the CTO role at Acme Manufacturing—and seeing the new Pune expansion makes it clear how fast things are moving at Acme Manufacturing right now.

When a CTO steps into a new mandate during an active growth phase, the biggest early hurdle usually isn't setting the architecture vision—it's untangling brittle data handoffs and manual glue code so they don't slow down your first-90-day wins.

At Acme Technologies, we partner with manufacturing CTOs to stand up production-ready enterprise AI platform foundations and governance in weeks—without a disruptive 6-month replatforming freeze.

Would you be open to a quick look at the 2-page architecture playbook we used for a similar manufacturing scale-up, or a brief 10-minute chat next week? Either way, wishing you and the Acme Manufacturing team continued momentum!

Warm regards,
Sales Lead
Acme Technologies

Hope you’re having a great week! It was exciting to read about Vertex Steel’s $85M electric arc furnace modernization—it’s an exciting time for the Vertex Steel team.

When plant engineering leaders roll out a major furnace or mill modernization, the toughest hurdle before commissioning usually isn't installing the hardware—it's unifying high-frequency sensor telemetry across legacy PLCs and historian systems so predictive maintenance models have clean, reliable data.

At Acme Technologies, we built our data pipeline toolkit specifically to unify real-time plant telemetry and automate anomaly detection pipelines in weeks—without pulling your plant engineers off the floor.

Would you be open to a quick look at the 2-page architecture playbook we used for a similar industrial manufacturing scale-up, or a brief 10-minute chat next week? Either way, wishing you and the Vertex Steel team continued momentum!
